data.notes: February’s confirmed calendar is led by electronic and outdoor weekender culture, with Cape Town club/beach events plus Western Cape festival trips within the broader Cape Town travel orbit.

events.title: Black Coffee Weekender 2027
events.summary: Black Coffee curates a three-day Cape Town weekender featuring a Friday charity dinner, Saturday main event and Sunday afterparty. The confirmed Saturday main event at The Ostrich features Black Coffee and Dixon, with more artists to be announced.

events.title: Black Coffee Weekender 2027 — Main Event
events.summary: The Saturday main event of Black Coffee’s three-day Cape Town Weekender is confirmed at The Ostrich, curated by Black Coffee with Dixon announced and a wider Afro-house/deep-house/electronic lineup still TBA.

events.title: Up The Creek Music Festival 2027
events.summary: South Africa’s long-running riverside music festival returns on the Breede River near Swellendam with four days, four stages and 50+ live acts. Early announced names include Arno Carstens, aKING, BCUC, Barto, Georgetown, Keanan Eksteen, Pedro Barbosa and SUGARBIRD.

events.title: Liquicity Cape Town 2027
events.summary: Liquicity brings its drum & bass brand back to Cape Town for a one-day summer edition at The Ostrich. Dimension is confirmed on the lineup, with more acts to be announced.

events.title: Pandora: Aeon
events.summary: Pandora returns to Stanford Hills Wine Estate for Aeon, a three-day music, art and nature gathering built around immersive spaces, sound journeys, workshops, installations and dance floors.

events.title: Paradisco - Love Sensation
events.summary: Paradisco’s Valentine weekend edition runs from late afternoon into the night at Grand Africa Cafe & Beach. The event is billed as a disco-to-house celebration, with tickets and tables marked as coming soon.

events.title: Cape Town AI Music Indaba 2027
events.venueName: One Thibault Hotel by ITC Hospitality
events.summary: The third Cape Town AI Music Indaba is a two-day summit on artificial intelligence in music creation, distribution and rights. The programme is set to include keynotes, demos and industry deal-making for artists, producers, tech founders and legal experts.
